title: Tempo-synced beat visualizer
summary: Rings, an equaliser or kinetic shapes hit on every kick of a music bed and accent each downbeat, under a show or mix title; picture and music share one locked tempo so every hit lands on its beat.
needs: A show, mix, channel or event name in the brief
For your own music: a cleared track at the locked tempo whose first downbeat is at 0 s
techniques: tempo clock (bpm, beats per bar, offset)
gallery_share: Audio visualizers for mixes, podcasts and radio shows are among the most requested music-driven loops.
limits: Synced by tempo, not by analysing audio: the bars are not a real spectrum, and a track with tempo drift or a different BPM will not stay in sync
One typeface (Inter or the system sans)
Hits are frame-quantised: exact at tempos whose beat is a whole number of frames (120 BPM at 30 fps), otherwise within half a frame
